question.text: Roots of the equation $x^2+b x-c=0(b, c\gt0)$ are

solution.text:
We know that, if roots are of same sign $\Rightarrow$ Product of root is + ve if roots are of opposite sign $\Rightarrow$ Product of roots is -ve Here, $x^2+b x-c=0$ (b, $c\gt0$ )
Product of roots $=\frac{-c}{1}=-\mathrm{ve}$
$\therefore$ Roots are of opposite sign.
